items.title: South Korea says AI agents appear to have been used to hack the country's banks

Last week some of South Korea's biggest banks were hit by a cyberattack. We now know the entire hack may have been done by a single person. He used a combined stack of an open-source AI penetration tool named ARTEX, DeepSeek v4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3, Grok 4.6, and Claude Code (CrowdStrike)
